significance: For every n ≥ 8, some permutation of length n takes at least n + 3 passes of the consecutive-231 stack map to reach a periodic point.
prior_work: Seidel and Sun ask about the maximal transient length. Kai Yi gives a uniform lower bound of n − 1 and asks whether the maximum divided by n diverges. The bound here leaves that growth question open. Priority beyond the cited comparison remains undetermined.
